definitions.explanation: The overall appearance of a town or street, especially the line of buildings along a road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{町並|まちな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{町並|まちな}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked through the beautiful streets of Kyoto.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧な{町並|まちな}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{条例|じょうれい}→条例：08255_jourei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定|さだ}めている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: This area has established regulations to preserve its historic townscape.

notes:
{町並|まちな}み describes the overall appearance and atmosphere of a town's streets and buildings, especially when viewed as a unified landscape.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {町並|まちな}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to preserve the townscape
- ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧な{町並|まちな}み: historic townscape
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{町並|まちな}み: old-style streets
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{町並|まちな}み: beautiful streetscape
- {町並|まちな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: the townscape is preserved/survives

FAMOUS EXAMPLES IN JAPAN:
- ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧: traditional wooden townhouses (⟦{町家|まちや}→町家：22291_machiya⟧)
- {金沢|かなざわ}: ⟦{武家|ぶけ}{屋敷|やしき}→武家屋敷：24803_bukeyashiki⟧ (samurai residences) districts
- {倉敷|くらしき}: white-walled warehouses
- {高山|たかやま}: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{町並|まちな}み preservation district

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{景観|けいかん}→景観：12976_keikan⟧: scenery, landscape (broader, includes natural features)
- {街並|まちな}み: same meaning, alternate kanji (⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧ emphasizes urban streets)
